failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS orders_2017,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) AS orders_2018,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018)
    - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS growth_abs,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018)
     - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017))::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017), 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS growth_pct
FROM orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12;

failures.question: 首单在 2017 年上半年的用户，在 2017 年下半年是否再次下单？按月留存率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH first_order AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS uid,
           MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT uid,
           date_trunc('month', first_ts)::date AS cohort_month
    FROM first_order
    WHERE first_ts >= timestamp '2017-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND first_ts <  timestamp '2017-07-01 00:00:00'
),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users
    FROM cohort
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
months AS (
    SELECT generate_series(date '2017-07-01', date '2017-12-01', interval '1 month')::date AS activity_month
),
retained AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.cohort_month,
           c.customer_unique_id AS uid,
           date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS activity_month
    FROM cohort co
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = co.uid
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= timestamp '2017-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  timestamp '2018-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT cs.cohort_month,
       m.activity_month,
       cs.cohort_users,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.uid) AS retained_users,
       ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.uid)::numeric / cs.cohort_users, 4) AS retention_rate
FROM cohort_size cs
CROSS JOIN months m
LEFT JOIN retained r
       ON r.cohort_month = cs.cohort_month
      AND r.activity_month = m.activity_month
GROUP BY cs.cohort_month, m.activity_month, cs.cohort_users
ORDER BY cs.cohort_month, m.activity_month
LIMIT 100;
